body.name: Correlated-sign mean-only witness
body.construction: Set \(S=1\), \(H=1\), \(W_{1i,-1}=1\), and fix \(0<a_{\mathrm w}<1\). For \(\rho\in\mathcal R\), define the event and historical sign pairs by \[P_\rho(U_{1i}=u,V_{1i}=v\mid z_{01}=x,E_0)=P_\rho(U_{1ti}=u,V_{1ti}=v\mid X_{1t}=x,E_0)=\frac{1+\rho(x)uv}{4},\qquad u,v\in\{-1,1\}.\] Set \(R_{1i0}(0)=a_{\mathrm w}U_{1i}\), \(R_{1i1}(0)=a_{\mathrm w}V_{1i}\), and \(R_{1ih}(1)=0\), so \(B_{1i}(1)=1\). At each historical window use conditionally independent sign-pair copies across units and set \(Q_{1ti}=(1+a_{\mathrm w}U_{1ti})(1+a_{\mathrm w}V_{1ti})\). Complete the remaining panel and donor variables independently within the maintained envelopes, with an i.i.d. calendar process and nondegenerate conditional response variance.
